source_en: First shift? I can tell. Don't mention the face.
Pavle Asatiani. The Butcher. My job, not a nickname.
Meat grinder. You feel it an hour later.
End of the market row. Scared people eat.
Ration meat, mostly. Nobody asks what animal.
He cried for a week. I'm [[whisper:the one wearing it]].
Keep asking questions like that. You'll do fine here.
